cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The ceiling's hungry. Turn the breakfast tray upside down so it can eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Keep half for us. Just turn its bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it under the light fitting; that's where it dribbled yesterday.
